steps.name: publish
argv:
import glob, hashlib, os, shutil
dst = r"C:\banyan-farm\courier-box\farm-out\lora-sapling-0822"
os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
src = sorted(glob.glob(r"C:\banyan-farm\lora-sapling-0822\out\SAMPLE-*.png")
             + glob.glob(r"C:\banyan-farm\lora-sapling-0822\out\SAMPLE-*.meta.yaml"))
lines = []
for f in src:
    shutil.copy2(f, dst)
    with open(os.path.join(dst, os.path.basename(f)), "rb") as fh:
        lines.append(hashlib.sha256(fh.read()).hexdigest() + "  " + os.path.basename(f))
# The weights stay on the box, but their hashes travel -- otherwise a sample
# is traceable only to a filename, and a filename is not bytes.
for w in sorted(glob.glob(r"C:\banyan-farm\lora-sapling-0822\out\*.safetensors")):
    with open(w, "rb") as fh:
        lines.append(hashlib.sha256(fh.read()).hexdigest()
                     + "  ON-BOX-ONLY " + os.path.basename(w))
with open(os.path.join(dst, "lora-sapling-0822.sha256"), "w", newline="\n") as fh:
    fh.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
print("published", len(src), "file(s) ->", dst)
raise SystemExit(0 if len(src) >= 6 else 1)
